Name: OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits Scaleup Unofficial version and Disabled Dialogue Portraits fix
Author: DarkChoco6869
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This Mod fix the problem when you install Mud's Skimpy Anime Portraits([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29979]Bountiful Beauties Vol.1[/url]& [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37227]Bountiful Beauties Vol.2[/url]) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32397]OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits[/url] the Shop Portraits won't load cause of conflict between ScaleUp Unofficial and sprites in details. It also fix the jumbled four vanilla Portraits.png showed up when a character is disabled at the configuration menu. This issue is caused by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36670]Resize Dialogue Offsets[/url] but with my mod Mud's , TwoCircles and Resize Dialogue Offsets can work seamlessly.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
 
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]First extract my zip file and the original OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits zip file and and copy all .png images from the character folder in original mod to mine  and make sure to not put anything in scaleup folder(Original Mod sprites in vanilla resolution). Then copy all .png images and other folders except json and Characters from the assets to mine , make sure to not touch json folder and it is done now. Put [CP] OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits(ScaleUp) folder in mod folder and enjoy.[/color][/size]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=3]And [/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=5][b]IGNORE the [CP]  Shop Portraits [/b][/size][/color][color=#d9d2e9][size=3]folder , I already put those in the mod.[/size][/color]


[b][color=#ff0000][size=5]SPECIAL NOTE[/size][/color][/b]

If four Portraits .png of OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits is showing up in the dialogue box then it is most probably caused by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5335]Change Dialogue[/url]. So , just go to  change dialogue section in the configuration mod menu and look for the problematic character set the [b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Portraits and Sprites to Other[/size][/color][/b].

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

All the mods required by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32397]OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits[/url] Except Sprites in details.
Instead it uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813]ScaleUp Unofficial[/url] .


[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Request to the Original Author :[/b][/size][/color]

This mod contains the Shop Portraits which I used without permission. If the author has problem,  I would immediately remove it . As the original shop Portraits are at 450x450 resolution it need to down scale to 256x256 to work with 4x scale up.
